correctness.rationale: For each reflection the fixed barycentric points are precisely unions of pairwise compatible admissible edge-orbits, with orbit-weights providing an actual PL homeomorphism to the orbit complex. Independent fresh enumeration reconstructed exactly 37 grid edges; column reflection has 20 admissible orbit vertices, 2636 total faces and 10996 Hasse incidences; row reflection 14 vertices, 1156 faces and 4828 incidences. The prescribed greedy Morse matching was independently regenerated and topologically sorted: column 1314 pairs and critical cells 2 in dimension 3, 6 in dimension 4, row 578 pairs and no critical augmented faces. Independent signed integral gradient elimination reproduced precisely the 6×2 matrix [[0,1],[-1,0],[1,-1],[0,0],[0,0],[0,0]]. Its first two rows have determinant 1. Since π3(S³∨S³)=Z², the two primitive 4-cell attaching maps cancel both 3-cells, leaving four S⁴ summands; row matching collapses to a point. Finite complete enumeration is an exhaustive proof for this one finite graph.
